# Samuel Jensen

> Samuel Jensen: engineer, rower and golfer. MSc student at SDU, racing the single for Odense Roklub.

The personal website of Samuel Gustav Jensen, in English (/en), Danish (/da) and French (/fr). There are no contact forms: to get in touch, email the address on the Contact page.
